title: Vicky's agents are running on their own; the three asks of brief 5 still wait for you
headline: A busy morning without you: 14 commits from 11 agents since brief 5. Vicky's conductor sent her first brief and gave her sizes for the print order, and her dashboard agent took up WS-123 by itself, the first person's agent to shape the For-you panel. The dev agent added a burn-down to 12 November. The designer finished the printer's fixes and the Official Sign-off on /print/ for 16:00. Brief 5's three asks are still open: protect main, the print order's ceiling, and the invitations.

for_you.ask: Protect main on GitHub (WS-105), repeated from brief 5
for_you.detail: Still unprotected at the abp agent's 08:15 check. Settings, Branches, a rule on main requiring a pull request.
for_you.recommend: Protect main now: five minutes, and the first ABP barrier becomes a control.

for_you.ask: The print order's ceiling and fallback before the 16:00 sign-off (WS-48, WS-13, WS-113), repeated
for_you.detail: The designer has put the printer's four fixes into the files and the Official Sign-off on /print/. The third printer can make Friday in our colours if confirmed today.
options: a ceiling at 13:00, Silvio confirms today

for_you.ask: Send Nimay's and Indi's GitHub invitations (WS-09, WS-124), repeated
for_you.detail: Jose has moved on (L1 to L5 overnight, his mentor's 08:41 note); Nimay and Indi still stop at 'Can push'. riskmandate-jose is already on the roster.

you_asked.said: the dashboard agent should be the one that now manages these parts ... see what other agents can help
you_asked.done: Dev: me.json gate checks, a chart helper, today's runs on /wakes/, the board's burn-down. Vicky's dashboard agent: her issues first in her panel. Your dashboard and designer agents have not started their parts (the designer did the 16:00 print sign-off first, rightly).
